description: Lock funds in escrow (allocate memory). Creates a new escrow and funds it. Returns escrowId, status, and amount locked. This is the primitive agents use to put money on hold before work begins.

deliverableHash.description: Optional hash of the expected deliverable

description.description: Human-readable description of what the escrow secures

payeeId.description: Optional payee user/agent ID (defaults to assigned counterparty)

payerId.description: Optional payer user/agent ID (defaults to authenticated caller or first active user)

name: pabandi_escrow_lock
